findings.text: The _critical_path_links docstring still says '``holds`` carries every open gate and every unmet wait beside the state' (reckon/roadmap.py:3302) while the state sentence above it was updated to say 'an unmet wait or an open decision names it'; the function it documents now returns open decisions too, so the module describes one payload two ways.

test_a_link_held_by_an_open_decision_names_that_decision supplies only a decision hold, so the ordering the same commit documents ('a decision ranks between them', reckon/roadmap.py:3245) is untested: a regression that appended decisions after waits would pass all seven cases while a link held by both a decision and an unmet wait would report the dependency ref as `wait` instead of the decision id.

The fragment still says the module carries 'five cases over tests/fixtures/coordinator_board_0850/' (line 36) and that the head arm 'passes all five' (line 93), while the arms paragraph this commit rewrote in the same file says seven pass at the head and six at the repaired base; a reader reconciling the two cannot tell which count describes the module at this head.

The gained commits change reckon/roadmap.py, but the three-file gate the done_when names is recorded only at the review base (logs/repair_gate.log, 23 passed at 6d76ede655); the head arm runs tests/test_the_critical_path_reads_link_by_link.py alone.
